fact: The World Bank's completion report of 15 August 2022 states that Angola had no functional national EMIS when the Learning for All Project was prepared, that IDA funds bought the SIGE software licence and paid for training and a better school questionnaire so that the ministry could produce the yearly Cadastro after the oil crisis cut the government's share, and that the SIGE has been absorbed by GEPE and is used in PAT-2.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report on a Credit in the Amount of SDR 48.80 Million (US$75 Million Equivalent) to the Republic of Angola for the Angola Learning for All Project
